Vendored cryptography: noble-bundle.js is a single-file esbuild bundle (minified, no network access, no CDN) of exactly these packages, all MIT licensed by Paul Miller (https://paulmillr.com):
  @noble/curves 1.9.7 (x25519), @noble/ciphers 1.3.0 (chacha20poly1305), @noble/hashes 1.8.0 (sha256, hmac, hkdf)
Built from entry: export { x25519 } from '@noble/curves/ed25519'; export { chacha20poly1305 } from '@noble/ciphers/chacha'; export { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha2'; export { hmac } from '@noble/hashes/hmac'; export { hkdf } from '@noble/hashes/hkdf';
The module self-tests it at load against known-answer values produced with Node's OpenSSL (node:crypto).
